decisions.reason: The necessary parallel change is already fully represented by the candidate's message-195 MODIFY, including replacement of the reach study with a length-only study and removal of the obsolete right_arm_reach_study key.
The candidate already has a complete message-195 MODIFY applying the same length-only adjustment and locked geometry constraints to the É accent.

The existing message-195 MODIFY already records the controlled Option B length study, subtly softened variant, Option C comparison, cross-glyph consistency rule, and removal of the obsolete refinement_variants key.
Applying the same adjustment to the Hero V and É accent preserves the existing shared-peak alignment rule; the source does not revise that rule.
The source changes glyph geometry for a controlled study while explicitly treating the finish as locked; it does not change the selected material, finish, or gold distribution.
The source confines the study to the Hero V, second V, and É accent and states that overall architecture and proportions are locked, leaving the E and L requirements unchanged.
The source changes the second V's right-arm length within its glyph geometry but does not revise its subordinate scale, cap-height relationship, or visual hierarchy.
The client explicitly says spacing is locked, so the selected Balanced Flow kerning and cohesive-reading requirement remain unchanged.
The source does not change the E/L cap-height rule and explicitly locks overall proportions during the right-arm length study.
Extending the right arm along its existing line does not alter the bottom-point common-baseline requirement.
The source provides refinement instructions but does not change the standing requirement to explain the design intention and translation rationale for review rounds.
